levels.surface: أبو صالح عبد الله بن صالح

notes: Route 1 is the main chain; «بهذا الحديث» is its back-reference. The Malik, Zuhri-Salim and Salim-father routes are remarks naming other transmitters for the same matn (variant, rule 4). Tirmidhi's own comment («قال أبو عيسى ... سألت محمدا») is not a route.
Occurrence numbers for «الزهري» and «سالم» follow their order in the text; the variant group 4 repeats the names for the Malik route.
